newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU inflation flat at 2.2 pct yr-on-yr in December.
newsitem.headline: EU inflation flat at 2.2 pct yr-on-yr in December.

text.p: Inflation in the European Union remained unchanged at 2.2 percent year-on-year in December, the lowest since the bloc began combining data, Eurostat said on Monday.
It compared with a year-on-year inflation rate of 3.0 percent in December 1995.
The Luxembourg-based statistics agency said inflation was highest in Greece at 7.5 percent. By contrast, prices fell in Sweden by 0.2 percent year-on-year.

Eurostat said the overall picture for inflation was the lowest since it began tracking EU data in 1983. The 2.2 percent figure compared with 3.3 percent in the United States, 2.2 percent in Canada, and 0.2 percent in Japan.
